title: ID0417540-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312567479/23] Terminal error
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
The terminal appears as out of order, in the error flags I see that the fuses are circuit breaker "trip of one of the fuses FC12 to FC17" and a converter fault absent "Missing Converters in DC2". Could you look to help me solve the problem?
